question: Can format-preserving local refinement activate under a current-state-only no-regression admission rule without gifting fine slices from an existing coarse blob?
mechanism: For each update, compare the exact current generation cost of ordinary shipping coarse CDC versus refining every non-reused coarse chunk into ordinary 16/64/256KiB resemblance.fastcdc leaves. Fine leaves may reuse only hashes physically present in prior committed generations. Commit refinement only when that generation is strictly smaller.
observation: Refinement was selected 0 times. Before fine leaves exist physically, splitting a changed coarse chunk cannot beat storing that same changed bytes directly because it adds blob framing and S_CDC entry metadata. The earlier cumulative byte headroom requires paying a seeding/migration generation first; it is not current-state-safe admission.
decision: FORMAT_PRESERVING_LOCAL_REFINEMENT_NARROWED. Do not prototype it as the next product path under the zero-byte current-state regression discipline. Re-elevate the existing Issue #26 depth-1 reference-delta route, which can exploit the already-present ordinary coarse parent on the first changed generation.
